title: Extension-Authored Domain Action
intent: Wrap semantic and graphical primitives inside one traceable extension action with explicit ownership and materialization.
useWhen: Use this recipe when an extension author must add a domain operation not provided by the ordinary chart-authoring API.
avoidWhen: Avoid this recipe for ordinary charts that can be expressed with existing domain actions, facades, or focused edits.
prerequisites: Provide immutable row objects containing every field named by the selected actions and example program.
Use explicit public resource identifiers whenever current program state contains more than one compatible candidate.

inputs.name: values
inputs.description: An array of plain row objects containing the fields required by this task.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Task-specific field names, resource identifiers, and supported visual or statistical choices.

outcomes: Wrap semantic and graphical primitives inside one traceable extension action with explicit ownership and materialization.

steps.instruction: Apply the primary action that produces the recognizable extension-authored domain action result or workflow.
Choose only the focused extension-authored domain action components required by the task; mutually exclusive creation alternatives are demonstrated as independent chart variants.
Use the focused lifecycle actions only after their owned extension-authored domain action resources exist and are uniquely targeted.

alternatives.when: Choose a neighboring recipe when its stated result and data roles match the requested chart more directly.
alternatives.instruction: Prefer one complete domain facade or task recipe before composing lower-level actions manually.

pitfalls.problem: Implicit targeting fails when several compatible datasets, marks, scales, guides, or owners exist in the same program.
pitfalls.fix: Pass the exact public identifier named by the action signature instead of relying on first-resource selection.
